works.title: Decoding the ancient Greek astronomical calculator known as the Antikythera Mechanism

works.title: The Reconstruction of the Antikythera Mechanism

works.title: Mysteries of computer from 65 BC are solved

works.why: General source cited on the device's historical mystery status.

works.title: Ancient Device Was Used To Predict Olympic Games
works.why: News coverage of the games-dial discovery.

works.title: Olympic link to early 'computer'

works.title: Does it favour a Heliocentric, or Geocentric Universe?

works.title: The Physics Book
works.why: General reference cited on the Moon's elliptical-orbit speed variation.

works.why: Ancient text describing two planetarium-like devices built by Archimedes, a key ancient parallel.

works.title: Archimedes: Spheres and Planetaria (Introduction)

works.title: The Song Dynasty in China
works.why: Background source on Su Song's clock tower era context.

works.title: The Antikythera Mechanism: Physical and Intellectual Salvage from the 1st Century B.C.
works.why: Further reading on the mechanism's intellectual and physical recovery.

works.title: The Forgotten Revolution: How Science Was Born in 300 BC and Why It Had To Be Reborn
works.why: Further reading cited on the scientific tradition behind devices like the mechanism.

works.title: The Antikythera Shipwreck Reconsidered
works.authors: Weinberg, Grace, Edwards, Robinson, et al.
works.why: Early reassessment of the shipwreck's contents and dating, further reading on context.
